name: cold_start_observed_dispatch_trace
status: verified live dispatcher trace for the captured input run; incomplete full opening stream

capture.mapper: MMC3 PRG mode-aware; effective slots logged
capture.note: Dispatcher rows are sampled at interpreter entry; next_dispatch_* is the observed post-handler continuation. The title input was not confirmed.
capture.frame_semantics: source_frame and next_dispatch_frame are observed end-to-end timing in the replay. They include the game main-loop/frame waits and do not isolate opcode wait cost.

observed_source_ranges.interpretation: FE at $A29E is dispatched and loops to $A020.
partial replay ends when outer Start/title transition changes the shared script pointer; not a terminal cutscene boundary.

classification.text_byte: $00-$D7 dispatched via text/glyph path; values are original tile IDs, not Unicode. Handler dispatch advances one byte; next byte may also be text or a control command.
classification.compact_pause: $D8-$DF inline waits; exact frame operands from ROM table are stored per event.
classification.cursor_back: $E0-$E7 inline cursor-back operation by opcode minus $E0 tiles.
classification.vector_command: E8-FF use bank-0 vectors. The trace records consumed ROM bytes, handler targets, mapper slots and observed pointer continuations. Source-addressed effects for first-pass vector opcodes are in cold_start_vector_handler_semantics.md.

verified_gaps: No complete semantic model of each vector handler side effect or variable operand format yet.
Capture stops during replay at $A050 when title transition changes pointer to $00E8; it does not prove the whole opening stream or a terminal command.
Title transition PC trace is separately bounded to source frame 4661–4692; raster visibility/PPU commit timing is not proven by this dispatch trace.
The old counted-FC/$A6DB expansion is withdrawn; retained only as historical evidence.
Observed dispatch frame spacing is end-to-end main-loop timing; opcode-specific delay cost is not isolated from concurrent game-loop waits.

Some handler effects are now source-traced, including FC RAM updates and ED sound-queue writes; indirect helper consumers, final PPU/APU commit timing and command-to-visible-frame attribution remain incomplete.
